text: [shyly][happy] I made two. [flat, pleased] One's for you. [pause][chuckles softly] …Don't look at me like that.
[giggles][too long] Sweet egg… [smiling][bubbly] for my sweet boy.
[sudden flat][quiet] …I woke up at four [sweet] for this.
[happy][bubbly] Sweet. Like me. [perfectly even][smiling] Good input.
[sing-song] Sweet, ne? [proud][slow] I rolled it. Myself.
[sudden flat][quiet] Say that again. Slowly. So I can write it… [sweet] down.
[whispers][close] A minute. [whispers, slower] Then another. [whispers, slowest] Then the whole day.
[excited] Yay! Park first. [flat, pleased] I already planned it.
